title: SpaceX估值过高：回落是自然修正，彭博策略师说透
speaker: Cameron Christ

segments.en: Yeah, I mean, if you look at SpaceX's financials and you didn't know Elon Musk was associated with the company, you probably wouldn't touch it with a barge pole.
segments.zh: 如果只看财务数据，不知道马斯克关联，可能没人会碰。

segments.en: You don't think that prospect is full of pictures of rocket ships we're inspiring.
segments.zh: 前景并非充满火箭船的鼓舞画面。

segments.en: I think paying 100 times revenues is not the typical path to fame and fortune in the investing or speculating game.
segments.zh: 支付100倍收入并非通往财富的典型路径。

segments.en: So, yeah, we've seen this thing before with a lot of high-profile IPOs.
segments.zh: 这种情形在众多高关注度IPO中屡见不鲜。
